readme: What a headless Godot process cannot do, on any platform. sandbox/LinuxRelease.ps1 and RunCiSuites.ps1 both read this file, so the two headless runs share one list and neither grows its own. headlessOnly names the suites that cannot pass headless by construction, each with the reason: each reads back something only a real renderer or a real display produces. Every entry was run headless from the Windows export of the same commit against a Windows extraction of the same shape and failed there too, so an entry here is never a Linux finding. LinuxRelease.ps1 still runs them and reports one that passes, so a stale entry is seen; none may be on SuiteCatalog.CiTier, which a unit test checks. headlessEngineErrors maps a regex to the reason for engine error lines a headless process prints and a windowed one does not: the same run from the Windows export prints each, at the same counts. An intermittent engine race cannot meet that, so its evidence is a game-free reproduction and the upstream issue, both named in its reason. The harness's own allowlist is written for the windowed battery, so a headless run applies these to the report's unexpected lines, by pattern, and every other unexpected line still fails it. Add an entry only on that evidence, never to turn a run green.

headlessOnly.build-stamp-focus: pushes a click at the logs icon's laid-out centre, which a headless window of no size places outside the viewport
headlessOnly.cloud-field-fade: reads the cloud cards' normals back out of the built mesh, which the headless dummy renderer does not store
headlessOnly.clutter-activation: reads each stamp's drawn state back from the clutter MultiMesh's instance transforms, which the headless renderer keeps no instances for
headlessOnly.clutter-cells: reads every placement back through the clutter cells' MultiMesh instance transforms, which the headless renderer keeps no instances for
headlessOnly.clutter-card-depth: counts rendered pixels in a viewport; headless renders none
headlessOnly.display-mode: asserts on the window mode of a real window; the headless display server has none
headlessOnly.display-monitor: enumerates screens; the headless display server reports none
headlessOnly.display-resolution: reads the screen size; the headless display server reports 0x0
headlessOnly.display-vsync: applies V-Sync to a real window's swap chain; headless has none
headlessOnly.fog-per-view: reads each splitscreen pane's rendered fog colour back from its viewport; headless renders none
headlessOnly.graphics-live-switch: reads the drawn clutter buffers and every texture's image back after each switch, which the headless renderer keeps neither of
headlessOnly.menu-original-tracer: reads the OS pointer's visibility and the monitor list from the display server, which headless does not provide
headlessOnly.menu-screenshot-key: captures the viewport texture to a PNG; headless draws nothing, so every file is empty
headlessOnly.muzzle-flash-rides-muzzle: reads the flash quads' drawn instance transforms back, which the headless renderer does not keep
headlessOnly.puffer-fire-glow: reads each emitter column's MultiMesh instance custom data back, which the headless renderer does not keep
headlessOnly.puffer-smoke-sun: reads each emitter column's MultiMesh instance custom data back, which the headless renderer does not keep
headlessOnly.sun-per-view: counts each splitscreen pane's rendered aircraft pixels and reads their shade back; headless renders none
headlessOnly.trail-world-anchor: reads the first drawn puff's instance transform back, which the headless renderer does not keep
headlessOnly.wing-flare-pose: counts the flare's rendered pixels in a viewport; headless renders none

headlessEngineErrors.texture_2d_get \\(\\./servers/rendering/: the dummy renderer holds no texture data to read back
headlessEngineErrors.(_shaped_text_add_string|_ensure_cache_f: a headless font has no rasterised size cache, so shaping at a measured size of 0 fails
headlessEngineErrors.The new image dimensions must match the: a graphics switch re-uploads an alpha-depth texture in place (TextureUpload.Replace), and a headless process reports a size mismatch the windowed battery does not
headlessEngineErrors.Parameter \"(material|m)\" is null\\. at: the dummy renderer keeps materials and meshes in RID owners that are not thread-safe in Godot 4.7, so under the separate render thread a lookup intermittently misses a live RID; a game-free GDScript loop reproduces it, and it prints at no fixed count because it is a race (godotengine/godot#121949, fixed by #121958 for 4.8; remove this entry when the project moves to 4.8)
